name: Launch Checklist
project_description:
This module allows for the documentation of website launch best practices by providing a checklist in the Drupal UI. Users with permissions will be able to view and action our recommendations to configure before you launch your site.

 The checklist is broken up into 14 sections. In each section, you will find items to check off if appropriate. Each item has a description, and helpful links to complete, or verify if it is already complete.

 Checking off items, and clicking save will store the time/date and the user who checked off the item into the database. This data can then be exported using Configuration synchronization to be stored in version control.
